script:
--[[
HEY STOP: Before you run this script, I would like to inform you that it uses some data. In the GUI, the script can display your Roblox username, your executor name, your Roblox account age, and your User ID (every account has an ID; it's nothing harmful). Please note that this does not apply to every script—it is only used in scripts where you can actively see this information (like your username, etc.) displayed directly in the UI itself. I assure you that this data is 100% visible only to you and is never forwarded anywhere.
]]

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://flowauth.net/v1/loaders/2a5ceaaf2827d13ab8f09e2fb8a6707d.lua"))()

--[[
It would be great if you could join my Discord so you don't miss any updates. My goal isn't to make money, but to build a community.
]]
features:
FARM
- Auto Farm (follows your active quest, takes it again, else nearest enemy)
- Auto Attack (nearby enemies, shows why nothing happens)
- Weapon dropdown (owned weapons only) + Auto Equip Combat Tool
- Auto Skills + Skills to use dropdown (skills of the held weapon)
- Insta Kill (rapid attack)
- Noclip while farming
- Bring + Freeze Mobs (limited, mobs are server owned)
- Farm targets dropdown + Blacklist dropdown
- Lock quest target until death
- Farm position (distance, height, position around enemy, priority)
- Smart distance (adjusts to your weapon)
- Teleport to nearest target
- Retreat + pause farm on low HP
- Auto respawn on low HP
- Auto return quest when done (and take it again)
- Quest stuck recovery
- Auto use Health Potion
- Anti AFK

PROGRESS
- Auto Progress (best quest for my level)
- Blocked quest retry + clear blocked quests
- Auto Skill Tree (nodes to unlock, unlock everything possible)

BOSS
- Auto Boss (turns on Auto Attack itself)
- End Game Farm (only bosses with World Events Chest)
- Bosses to kill dropdown

DUNGEONS
- Dungeon travel (Parkour, Grove Raid, Muzan's Lair, Final Selection Plains)
- Parkour checkpoints (teleport to any / last checkpoint)
- Auto Grove Raid (raiders + chests)
- Kill Raid Captain first
- Raid teleports (nearest raider / sealed chest)
- Ranked Tower info (season, time left)

QUEST
- Auto Activate Selected Quest (+ replace other active quest)
- Auto Interact Nearby
- Auto accept a quest when interacting (choice for NPCs with 2+ quests, preferred quests)
- Teleport to current objective
- Quest Giver picker (NPC dropdown + quest dropdown)
- Teleport to giver / accept selected quest / both

TELEPORT
- Region teleport (dropdown, select, next, previous)
- NPC teleport (dropdown)
- Black Market
- Quick trainer teleports (4)

PLAYER
- Noclip
- Speed Lock
- Infinite Jump
- God Mode (not perfect)
- Inventory helper (item dropdown, equip selected item, equip best Fishing Rod, unequip tools)
- Horse teleport / interact
- Auto Horse Taming (plays the minigame)
- Auto Training (Pushups, Meditation, Squat Rack, Cup Game, Aim Training)
- Auto Become Slayer
- Auto Become Demon
- Fly (WASD/Space/Ctrl)

PLAYER COMBAT
- Player Farm (auto attack players)
- Target priority, stay in place
- Filters (skip game protected, only PvP tagged, ignore friends / party / clan)
- Only attack / never attack lists
- Player ESP
- Spectate current target
- Teleport to / behind player

LOOT
- Auto Chest Loot
- Auto Loot Drops
- Auto Schematics
- Loot / chest route may interrupt farm
- Include locked chests
- Loot whitelist / blacklist + chest blacklist

ACTIVITIES
- Black Market Auto Buy (items dropdown, delay)
- Clan Spins (Spin Clan Once, Auto Clan Spin, stop on clan dropdown / rarity dropdown)
- Auto Fish (casts, plays the minigame itself, collects the catch)
- Get Fishing Permit (auto quest)
- Rod shop (rod dropdown, teleport to seller, buy)
- Muzan (status, teleport / interact, Muzan's Lair)

MISC
- NPC ESP
- Boss ESP
- Winter Immunity
- Auto Prompt
- Take Foxfire
- Unload Cryptic

SERVER
- Rejoin same server
- Server Hop (8 modes)
- Join by Job ID

UI SETTINGS
- Searchable dropdowns
- Configs (save / load / autoload)
